text: LANDED at merge 296bcc0 as c1049f2 in m1's stack. SignatureProjection returns a supported scalar carrying the MINIMUM support among contributing components plus the NAME of the component that set it, and the COUNT of weighted components carrying no support notion - so a support figure covering four of eleven terms cannot be misread as covering eleven. A component with NO VALUE still refuses (MissingComponent); one with a value but thin support contributes and may set the floor. Mutation P3 - drop Missing components instead of refusing, the option the chief's original wording would have instructed - fails 2 tests; under it the projection returns a sum over whichever components happened to be measured, labelled with the same version and weights as a full projection, so two signatures could be compared with one silently missing a dimension.
